description: Changes a project's own details: only what you send. instructions replaces the project's instructions; sourcing_notes replaces its Sourcing notes card (a project with no Sourcing phase gets one first, and the answer says so). view gallery opens the project with its renderings first and the items under them. claude_sourced true makes it a project Claude sources and manages: the gallery view then shows its three phases (step) — Design: the renderings by space with each space's cost and its Approve; Buy: the shopping cart per store with tax and the budget, the coded items, the sourcing notes; Install: the layout pictures, the instructions, the labels; it also sets the view to gallery unless view is sent. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

budget.description: The budget in dollars, all in (0 clears it)

claude_sourced.description: true: Claude sources and manages this project (the sourcing page); false: the ordinary gallery

instructions.description: The project's instructions, replacing the old ones

sourcing_notes.description: The Sourcing notes card, replacing what is there: markdown, ### headings, - bullets, [label](https://…) links. Send only the text; no date stamp

step.description: The phase the project is in: design (the renderings by space, each approved), buy (the cart and the items) or install (the layout, the instructions, the labels). budget is read as design and items as buy

tax_rate.description: Sales tax in percent for the cart, e.g. 7

name: update_project
title: Change a project
